events.title: 0.3.9 Version Update
events.summary: Added a toggle for Drink Making Tips in the Settings UI. When enabled, it shows the steps for making the drink the current customer wants and highlights the valid placement areas when dragging a partially finished item.Fixed an issue where looping sound effects did not stop at the end of a level.Fixed a texture display error caused by leftover filling animations on partially finished items.Fixed an issue where, after winning Challenge Mode, continuing to play incorrectly showed the final rent ro

events.title: 0.3.8 Version Update
events.summary: Improved the control feel: swiping to collect coins from the bar counter will no longer be interrupted.Adjusted the sound effects when serving dishes consecutively.Added a hint for the final rent round in Challenge Mode.The "Many Cups" card now only counts up to 5 drinks on the bar counter.Fixed an issue where the prologue music would still play even when music was turned off.Fixed an issue where the game would freeze when continuing after winning in Challenge Mode.

events.title: 0.3.7 Version Update
events.summary: In the summary information of the Level Mode UI, add hover tooltip explanatory text for each item.In the menu UI of Level Mode, add hover tooltip explanatory text for the price breakdown of each drink.In the calendar UI of Level Mode, make the hover information panel for each calendar item auto-adjust its height based on the content.Adjusted the rent values in Challenge Mode; Challenge Mode Difficulty 0 is now easier.Fixed an issue where drag detection could fail when continuously dragging drink
